description: Proof that every object the database references still exists in durable storage, unchanged, and that nothing has been orphaned.

metrics.description: Objects referenced by an active file version or preview artifact that are absent from durable storage.
metrics.measurementMethod: For each referenced storage key, issue a HEAD against the object store and count the misses.

metrics.description: Objects whose stored byte length differs from the recorded size.
metrics.measurementMethod: Compare the object store's reported content length against the size recorded on the row.

metrics.description: Objects whose content hash no longer matches the digest recorded at upload.
metrics.measurementMethod: Re-read a sampled object and compare its SHA-256 against the stored content hash.

metrics.description: Rows that point at a storage key which was never written.
metrics.measurementMethod: Count active file versions and preview artifacts whose storage key is empty or absent from the object store.

metrics.description: Stored objects that no live row references and that are not awaiting scheduled reclamation.
metrics.measurementMethod: List object keys under the managed prefixes and subtract keys referenced by file versions, preview artifacts, drafts and pending reclamations.

metrics.description: An object written by one process is readable, byte-identical, by another after a restart.
metrics.measurementMethod: Write a probe object, read it back through a fresh storage client, and compare the SHA-256.
